svg.title: Compact runtime flow: boot, admit, five nodes, response
svg.desc: One-page illustration of the shipped NL2SQL path. A boot line starts main.py, builds the FastAPI app and runs the lifespan probes. A request passes the operator gate, validation, admission and session binding. WorkflowRunner walks the fixed node order parse_nl, schema_linking, generate_sql, validate_sql, execute_sql. JSON and SSE return QueryResponse; MCP projects it. Guards and failure branches are summarised in two footnotes.
